title: MatchSnapshot
description: Everything a scoring model is allowed to see about a single match. Assembled by ingestion from canonical entities; consumed by models as their only input. A model that needs something not in here cannot have it.

kickoff_utc.description: Kickoff in UTC. Clients localise; models must not assume a timezone.

odds.description: Market prices. OPTIONAL — absent for matches with no market coverage, which is routine rather than exceptional. Models requiring odds features skip such matches.

form.description: Recent-form aggregates for both sides. OPTIONAL.

signals.description: Values produced by collectors and joined onto this match. OPTIONAL. This is the one region of the snapshot that is open: a collector adds a namespace without amending this schema, which is what lets a model developer bring a new signal without a Zone A change. Everything outside `signals` stays closed.

total_line.description: The over/under goals line, e.g. 2.5. This is the market's expected goal total and is the single most informative entertainment signal available.

home_price.description: Decimal odds for a home win. With draw and away prices, the spread of implied probabilities measures how evenly matched the sides are.

matches.description: How many recent matches the aggregates cover.

signal_namespace.description: One subject area's signals, e.g. `reddit`. Deliberately open: the schema cannot know what a collector will provide, so the guarantee that exactly one producer claims any given leaf path is enforced by the collector registry rather than here. A namespace fed by a team-keyed collector nests its values under `home` and `away`, which is the same shape `form` already uses.
